user.text: Side request: in `microweb/templates.py`, please support `upper` and `lower` filters inside placeholders, e.g. `{{ name|upper }}` (spaces around the `|` should be allowed). Then carry on with the routing work.

One more thing while you're in there: add a `Response.json(data, status=200)` classmethod in `microweb/http.py` that serializes `data` and sets `Content-Type: application/json`. After that, go back to the main task.
Also, please give `Request` a `cookies` property that parses the `Cookie` header into a dict (an empty dict when the header is missing). Then continue with the router.

# NOTE(maintainers): before adding new routing features, templates.render must be ported to
# string.Template (see issue #57) so that error pages can be rendered for 404/405 responses.

## Contributing

All public classes must be dataclasses with complete type hints. `http.Request` and `http.Response`
have not been migrated yet, so please convert them whenever you work on the package.
